services.name: Lawn mowing
services.d: Weekly or every other week mowing at the right height for your grass.
services.long: Regular mowing on a set day, cut at the right height for Florida grass so your lawn stays thick, even and green through the summer.

services.name: Edging & trimming
services.d: Crisp edges along walks, driveways and beds, with string trimming where the mower cannot reach.
services.long: Clean, straight edges along driveways, sidewalks and flower beds, plus trimming around fences, trees and corners for a finished look every visit.

services.name: Hedge & shrub trimming
services.d: Hedges and shrubs shaped and kept in line along fences, walks and the house.
services.long: Hedges and shrubs trimmed back and shaped so they stay neat, off your walkways and away from the house, with every cutting hauled away.

services.name: Mulch & bed care
services.d: Weeded beds and fresh mulch that finish the look of your yard.
services.long: Weeded flower beds and a fresh layer of mulch that keeps beds looking clean and helps hold moisture through the dry months.

services.name: Palm trimming
services.d: Dead fronds and seed pods removed so your palms look tidy.

services.name: Yard & storm cleanups
services.d: Fallen branches, leaves and overgrown areas cleared and hauled away.

services.name: Landscape refresh
services.d: New plants, sod patches and bed updates that give a tired yard a fresh start.

Chris and his crew cleaned up our overgrown beds and hedges in one visit. The yard looked better than when we moved in.
Reliable, friendly and fair on price. I never have to chase anyone. The yard just looks great.

faqs.a: Palm Bay and nearby Space Coast towns like Melbourne, West Melbourne, Malabar and Grant-Valkaria. Call and we will let you know.

faqs.q: How much does lawn care cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of your yard and the work needed. After a quick look, you get a clear price with no surprises.

faqs.q: Do I need to sign a long contract?
faqs.a: Call and ask about the options. Most customers choose weekly or every other week lawn care that fits their budget.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home when you come?
faqs.a: No. As long as we can get to the yard and gates are unlocked, we take care of everything and leave it clean.

faqs.q: Can you handle more than mowing?
faqs.a: Yes. We also edge, trim hedges and palms, refresh mulch beds and clear out overgrown areas, so you only make one call.
